newsitem.title: USA: SMC expects lower Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: SMC expects lower Q4 earnings.

text.p: SMC Corp said Thursday its plans to relocate its El Dorado production operations from Minneapolis, Kansas to Hines, Oregon would "significantly reduce" earnings for the fourth quarter of 1996.
"A slowdown in the industry as a whole, coupled with protracted start-up efforts at the new SMC Midwest operation has resulted in lower sales and profits than projected," it said.
SMC, which makes recreational vehicles, acquired the operations in Minneapolis, Kansas in June 1996.

"Unfortunately, the turn around of operating performance in Kansas is taking much longer than we originally planned," it said. The company expected the slowdown in vehicle sales across the industry to be temporary and begin expanding in 1997.

"We project that our 1996 sales will be 30 percent higher than 1995 results and we anticipate continued significant growth in 1997 as our dealer development remains strong and our product lines continue to perform well," it said.
SMC Co makes high-line motor coaches.
